name: Tiled background
summary: A small image that repeats in both directions behind a page. It fills any window size from one file.
how: Make a tile of 32px to 128px that joins at all 4 edges.
Keep the tile to 16 or 64 colours so that the file stays small.
Keep text in a bright colour on a dark tile, or in a dark colour on a pale tile.
Use a fixed position when the page scrolls.

origin.note: Netscape Navigator 1.1 added background images for pages.

adoptions.via: Free home page hosts make the tile a common ground for personal pages.
Profile owners set a wallpaper under their boxes with pasted CSS.
